recommendations.recommendation: Simplify your life; reduce your needs and possessions.
recommendations.rationale: Most luxuries are hindrances to elevation.

recommendations.recommendation: Live deliberately and face the essential facts of life.
recommendations.rationale: He did not want to find at death that he had not lived.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not spend your life earning more than needed; avoid overwork.
recommendations.rationale: Men are tools of their tools, losing life to labor.

recommendations.recommendation: Follow your own pace and convictions, not conformity.
recommendations.rationale: Each should march to the step he hears.

recommendations.recommendation: Spend time in nature and in solitude.
recommendations.rationale: Nature and solitude restore and teach.

recommendations.recommendation: Distrust fashion and novelty; value clothes and houses for use.
Be self-reliant, providing for your own needs.
recommendations.rationale: Experiment showed one can live on little labor.

recommendations.recommendation: Advance confidently in the direction of your dreams.
recommendations.rationale: Success comes unexpectedly to those who do.

recommendations.recommendation: Read the great books in the original and read deliberately.
recommendations.rationale: Classics are the noblest record of mankind.

recommendations.recommendation: Abstain from animal food if you wish a higher spiritual life.
recommendations.rationale: The higher nature is quickened by purity.
